textes.meta_titre: Domaine Vaison — Three houses a stone's throw from the Roman Theatre
textes.meta_description: Three houses for 4 people in a gated estate in Vaison-la-Romaine, a stone's throw from the Roman Theatre and 300 m from the town centre. Pool, garden, pétanque court. Open all year round.
textes.h1: Three houses a stone's throw from the Roman Theatre
textes.chapo: Olivier, Lavande and Les Cigales: three houses for 4 people in a gated estate in Vaison-la-Romaine, with a garden, a pétanque court and parking. Open all year round.
textes.maisons_intro: Three fully equipped houses for 4 people, each with its own private terrace, kitchen and bathroom. The garden, pool, pétanque court and car park are shared.
textes.ol_texte: Two identical houses, each with its own private terrace; Lavande's overlooks the pool. Simple, warm decor and a welcome basket on arrival.
textes.ol_chambres: One double bed 140 × 190, two single beds 90 × 190
textes.ol_cuisine: Gas cooker, fridge, washing machine, coffee maker
textes.ol_exterieur: Private terrace, overlooking the pool at Lavande
textes.ci_texte: The largest of the three, with two private terraces facing south and east. Sun loungers are provided.
textes.ci_couchages: 4 people, baby cot and extra bed available
textes.ci_chambres: One double bed, two single beds
textes.ci_exterieur: Two terraces, facing south and east
textes.sp_titre: On site, at no extra cost
textes.sp_texte: The gate closes: children play in the garden and your car stays inside while you walk into town.
textes.eq_piscine_d: 10 × 5 m, in the middle of the garden.
textes.eq_jardin_d: Lawn, flower beds and olive trees.
textes.au_texte: Vaison is made up of the Roman town, the medieval upper town and the modern town. Your hosts will recommend walks, vineyards and restaurants, and lend you the map of walking and cycling routes.
textes.au_sites: Roman sites of Puymin and La Villasse
textes.ta_intro: Prices per house per week. Minimum stay of 3 days in low and mid season, one week in high season.
textes.ta_basse: Low seasonJanuary to April, October to December
textes.ta_moyenne: Mid seasonMay, June and September
textes.ta_haute: High seasonsummer (school holidays) and public holidays
textes.ta_note: Check-in from 4 pm, check-out between 9 and 10 am. The exact price for your dates is shown when you select them in the booking calendar.
textes.ta_compris1: Pool, garden, pétanque court, gated car park and Wi-Fi
textes.ta_compris2: Loan of barbecue and pétanque boules
textes.ta_plus3: Baby cot and high chair: €15 per stay
textes.ta_plus5: Tourist tax: €1.70 per adult per day
textes.re_intro: Choose a house, then your dates. The calendar is the same as on our other platforms: a date shown as free here really is free.
textes.re_infos: Secure online payment and confirmation by email. A question before booking? Write to us.
textes.av_intro: Reviews left on Google, translated from French.
textes.av_1: “A very warm welcome from the owners. A few hundred metres from the town centre, a stone's throw from the theatre. A pool, a lovely setting. An ideal place to spend your holidays.”
textes.av_2: “Great location, the owners are very friendly and the pool is fantastic.”
textes.co_texte: Mr Brygo welcomes you all year round. For any question about the houses, options or booking, call, email or fill in the form.
textes.co_parking: Gated car park on the estate
textes.pied_texte: Three houses with a pool a stone's throw from the Roman Theatre in Vaison-la-Romaine. Open all year round.
